posts.title: Informing HTTP Extension Design with Data
posts.description: What 120 million HTTP responses from Common Crawl reveal about how protocol extensions actually get deployed — and what that should tell us when we design new ones.

posts.title: So You Want To Define a Well-Known URI
posts.description: When to reach for a well-known URI — and the traps that catch most protocol designers.

posts.title: Web Feeds in 2026: A Survey
posts.description: I looked through Common Crawl and found over 500,000 parseable RSS/Atom feeds, confirming that Web feeds are still a major part of the Open Web. But most aren’t high quality, and autodiscovery often points users at stale or abandoned feeds.
